name: Air Quality by Place Name
description: Current outdoor air quality for a named town or city, with what the readings mean for going outside. Takes a place name rather than coordinates.
runtime_reason: Composes two other tools and reshapes their output. No fetching of its own, no native dependencies.
creator: erics
note: The first moon: it makes no HTTP request itself. Both of its inputs come from other registered tools, resolved by the platform before its transform runs.

place.description: a town, city or region name
